spec.title: Cluster Summary
spec.description: Metrics and Logs summary of the supervised systems.

spec.expr: max(max by (mps_alloy_hostname) (node_load1{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"}) / count by (mps_alloy_hostname) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", mode="idle"}))

sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (src_ip) (count_over_time({job="syslog-auth.log"} |= "Failed password" | regexp `Failed password for (invalid user )?(?P<user>\S+) from (?P<src_ip>\S+) port` | src_ip!="" [$__range]))))
sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (ip) (count_over_time({job="fail2ban"} |~ "] Ban " | regexp `] Ban (?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+)` | ip!="" [$__range]))))
